title: Shape rewards without breaking them
summary: Small extra rewards can point new brains toward good ideas. Keep them small and hard to game.

steps.title: Too big to ignore
steps.body:
New brains almost never build cover by luck, so the idea of hiding behind boxes is hard to find. Shaping helps: small extra rewards for steps toward the goal, such as carrying a box.

A teammate added one, and it is broken. It has no `* dt`, so it pays 1 point every tick, which is 30 points per second. Hiding is worth at most 21 points in a match, one per second after prep. A hider that carries a box for a second outscores the best hider there is, so evolution would breed box carriers instead of hiders.

Press Check to see the test hider's score. Then make the bonus 0.1 point per second: `reward +0.1 * dt when agent.holding`.

check.message: The hider's score should stay under 22 points: at most 21 from hiding, plus a little.

hints: A reward that should pay per second is multiplied by dt.
Change the line to reward +0.1 * dt when agent.holding.

steps.title: Only while it helps
steps.body:
Even a small bonus can be gamed. This one pays for carrying a box all match long, even while the seeker watches. Carrying a box helps a hider during prep, when it can build cover in peace. After that it is a distraction.

Add `and agent.prep` to the bonus, so that it only pays during prep.

check.message: The carrying bonus should read agent.holding and agent.prep.

hints: and joins two conditions. Both must be true for the reward to pay.
Change the line to reward +0.1 * dt when agent.holding and agent.prep.

steps.title: Events pay once
steps.body:
Some things last, like being hidden or holding a box. Rewards for them pay per second, with `* dt`. Other things happen once, like locking a box. `agent.justLocked` is true for exactly one tick, the tick the lock happens, so a reward for it has no `dt`.

Add a bonus of 0.2 points for each box locked during prep: `reward +0.2 when agent.justLocked and agent.prep`.

check.message: Add a reward that reads agent.justLocked.

hints: It is a reward line like the others, with no dt.
Add reward +0.2 when agent.justLocked and agent.prep under the carrying bonus.

steps.title: Close the loophole
steps.body:
Every bonus is a promise, and evolution finds every way to collect it. A hider can lock a box, unlock it and lock it again, and get paid each time.

Make unlocking cost what locking pays: add `reward -0.2 when agent.justUnlocked`. Now flicking a lock on and off earns nothing. The only way to profit is to lock a box and leave it locked.

check.message: Add a penalty that reads agent.justUnlocked.

hints: agent.justUnlocked is true on the tick the agent unlocks a box.
Add reward -0.2 when agent.justUnlocked under the lock bonus.
